concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-in-person-post-launch-activities-network-connection-test]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree In-Person website guide for reader-admin Braintree-endpoint, internet, speed and time-server diagnostics, with firmware 5.1.0+, pairing and test-versus-production credential qualifications; the snapshot publishes no latency metric, and diagnostic connectivity or speed state is not current availability, reader-health, transaction or payment-outcome proof
warnings: The page labels a Speed Test but does not publish a latency value, unit, threshold or performance requirement.
Displayed failure rows and the E285 image are explanatory examples, not results from a specific merchant reader or network.
